summary: ITER154 retest. Backend regression PASSES (12/12 + 3 new). All 3 frontend fixes from iteration_153 (owner-gate skip, designer-chip testid, accounts pill count) are not confirmed via UI because the playwright login submit didn't progress the session — but a NEW CRITICAL backend bug was uncovered: POST /api/relationships/intake/answer-event?tenant_slug=mood-demo-studio-81a09e returns 404 'Tenant not found'. Only tenant_slug=studio resolves. The frontend ContinuationInterviewDrawer.jsx hardcodes the fallback slug to 'mood-demo-studio-81a09e' which the answer-event route rejects, so the Continuation Interview flow will break at every option click.

critical.issue: Returns 404 'Tenant not found' for tenant_slug=mood-demo-studio-81a09e (the same slug used by the rest of the storefront e.g. /api/storefront/public/mood-demo-studio-81a09e/* and /api/relationships/intake/groups?tenant_slug=mood-demo-studio-81a09e). Only tenant_slug=studio resolves on this route. Either: (a) the tenants table row has slug='studio' but status='active' while the duplicate slug 'mood-demo-studio-81a09e' is on a different row that is not active, OR (b) the route in /app/backend/routers/relationship_engine.py:67 filters tenants by status='active' too strictly. Confirm by SELECT id, slug, status FROM tenants WHERE slug IN ('studio','mood-demo-studio-81a09e'); — likely two rows exist.

integration_issues.issue: ContinuationInterviewDrawer.jsx:64 hardcodes the fallback tenant_slug to 'mood-demo-studio-81a09e' for the POST to /api/relationships/intake/answer-event. Even if the runtime tenantSlug prop is correctly threaded, this fallback is also the same slug used elsewhere in the app, so the answer-event POST will 404 unless the backend accepts this slug (see backend critical bug). User clicks on any option → 404 → drawer stuck.

rca of the issue: RCA · answer-event 404: routers/relationship_engine.py:66-69 queries tenants WHERE slug=:tenant_slug AND status='active'. The slug 'mood-demo-studio-81a09e' is referenced everywhere in the app (frontend storefront, ContinuationInterviewDrawer fallback, /intake/groups param) but on this route returns 'Tenant not found'. Probable cause: there are two tenant rows — one with slug='studio' (status=active) and one with slug='mood-demo-studio-81a09e' (status=trial/inactive). The /intake/groups route does NOT filter by status (it just resolves the catalog) so it returns 200, while /answer-event does — hence the asymmetric result. Fix: align the tenants.slug used across all endpoints, or remove the status='active' filter from the answer-event tenant lookup.
